actualdecimal.description: Shows the actual value (Decimal type) achieved towards the target as of the last rolled-up date.

actualinteger.description: Shows the actual value (integer) achieved towards the target as of the last rolled-up date.

actualmoney_base.description: Shows the actual value (money type) in base currency to track goal results against the target.
